name: Plan mode
summary: Have Claude explore the code and propose a plan before it changes anything.
what: In plan mode Claude can read files and look around the project, but it does not edit your source files. When it has worked out an approach, it shows you a plan. You approve it, ask for changes, or edit it yourself; only after approval does Claude start making changes.

impact.title: Agree before code changes
impact.detail: You see the approach for a large or risky change and correct it while it is still cheap to change.

impact.title: Safe exploration
impact.detail: Ask questions about an unfamiliar codebase without any risk of files being edited.

impact.title: You choose how it continues
impact.detail: On approval you decide whether Claude then works with edits accepted automatically or checked one by one.

howItWorks: Press Shift+Tab until the status bar shows plan mode, or start with claude --permission-mode plan.
Or type /plan followed by what you want, to plan a single request.
Claude reads files and explores, then presents its plan; press Ctrl+G to edit the plan in your editor.
Approve the plan to leave plan mode and choose the mode for the work, or choose to keep planning.
To leave without approving, press Shift+Tab when no approval prompt is open.

events.note: First changelog mention of plan mode; it shipped earlier without an entry.
Plan mode gained a dedicated Plan subagent.
